title: Industry Army Marketing Welcomes Naturopaths.io
excerpt: Naturopaths.io joins the network with sixteen guides on evidence, practitioner credentials and everyday wellbeing. A division of Treatments.tv, powered by IAM.
metaDescription: Introducing Naturopaths.io: sixteen source-linked guides for clearer health questions, checking credentials and understanding evidence. A division of Treatments.tv.

richContent.intro: What does a practitioner’s title mean? What did the research actually measure? What questions belong in a first appointment? [Naturopaths.io](https://naturopaths.io/) is a new educational site in our network, built to help readers begin with clear questions and visible sources.

sections.heading: Sixteen starting points for informed conversations
paragraphs: The launch library includes sixteen original guides across understanding naturopathy, choosing care, reading evidence, product safety and everyday wellbeing. Readers can start with a question rather than a product pitch: how to check a credential, prepare for a first visit or read the study behind a headline.

Each article links its references, including information from NIH and NCCIH, CDC, FDA or NHS. The site discusses individual approaches and the evidence relevant to them. It does not treat a broad label as proof that every product or practice works.

sections.heading: Know who you are speaking with
paragraphs: The [practitioner credential guide](https://naturopaths.io/guides/checking-practitioner-credentials/) focuses on the exact title, jurisdiction, regulator and permitted role. The [first-visit checklist](https://naturopaths.io/guides/questions-before-your-first-visit/) helps readers prepare questions about evidence, costs, consent and keeping their care connected.

Naturopaths.io publishes consumer education. It is not a clinical practice, a verified practitioner directory or a booking service. The launch does not establish any provider’s credentials or make a treatment recommendation for an individual reader.

sections.heading: A clear identity within Treatments.tv
paragraphs: The site pairs warm cream and green with readable type and an original botanical illustration. The main navigation keeps consumer guides and choosing-care information close. Practitioner, contribution and marketing resources sit in the footer.
Naturopaths.io is a division of [Treatments.tv](https://treatments.tv/). Powered by Industry Army Marketing.
Practitioner applications and article contributions have information pages, but submissions are not open at launch. No practitioner admission, placement or response is promised.

sections.heading: Explore the questions that matter to you
paragraphs: [Visit Naturopaths.io](https://naturopaths.io/), browse the sixteen guides and follow the references behind a subject. The publication’s purpose is to make the next conversation better informed, with evidence, uncertainty and the reader’s existing care team kept in view.

For IAM, this launch adds a focused health education resource to the network. Businesses interested in a clear website, brand or responsible publishing project can discuss their actual needs with IAM.
